supported_scope: Flavor lifting uses freeness of the cohomology target and a bounded-below graded kernel argument; it does not assume flatness of B_F.
Added-loop Euler factors are units at the specified graded-origin/nonzero-mass point, with coefficient-preserving localized Coulomb comparisons.
Prequotient subgroup localization avoids compensating gauge fixed points on the quotient.
Equality at the graded origin descends to equality of the full homogeneous coefficient ideals, retaining nilpotents.
The source's rotation and constructibility argument compares ordinary Betti numbers of all regular stabilities, including empty cases.
The final full-topological-torus comparison is conditional on the separate looped and kernel inputs.
remaining_gaps: The looped determinant comparison requires the unaccepted geometric kernel, cut-symbol, Laurent, and counting interfaces.
Polynomial coefficient-preserving BFN minuscule generation and flavor base change remain geometric source inputs.
The precise Brion subgroup-localization application to the locally closed stable prequotient and Weyl-invariant passage was not independently audited against its primary theorem.
Rotation/Kempf-Ness, regular-stability perturbation, Kirwan surjectivity, and compactly supported constructibility are external/source interfaces rather than results certified by the old artifacts.
The stability-cocharacter quotient still requires cocharacter-root; full-torus equality alone does not establish it.
